VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: The empty-intersection conclusion is reached by deriving incompatible valuation bounds (step 5.1). All edge cases are handled: the zero endpoint a_0=0 is treated separately (step 1.1, 2.1); positivity of a_1=t^{-1} is established (step 3.1); each interval is nonempty but their full intersection is empty; the contradictions at steps 4.1 and 4.2 cover equality at endpoints as well (the derived strict inequalities contradict the non‑strict interval inequalities). The two Archimedean choices (steps 4.1, 4.2) are licensed because their real inputs are positive. No degenerate or hidden cases invalidate the counterexample.
